source:
@@U04255@@
A throne, rich surroundings. 抢夺者 and 快掠女.

@@U04257@@
We got here first after all.

@@U04259@@
Faster than a raven’s flight!

@@U04261@@
Ah, and look at the treasure! Where do I start, where do I stop!

@@U04263@@
I never saw so much loot! What to grab first?

@@U04265@@
That rug would suit me nicely! You should see the miserable beds I sleep on.

@@U04267@@
Ah! And here! A steel-spiked mace! A dream come true!

@@U04269@@
Look here! A red cloak here with gold trim! I’ve wanted one of these for ever!

@@U04271@@
(Taking the mace from the wall.)

@@U04272@@
One good stroke with this and the brain’s a mush, then on to the next. Let’s see what you've got there. Ah! Junk! Leave it. Take one of these chests. The army’s pay. A bellyful of gold.
translation:
@@U04255@@
王座，环境富裕。 抢夺者和快掠女。

@@U04257@@
毕竟是我们先到的。

@@U04259@@
比乌鸦飞行还要快！

@@U04261@@
啊，看看宝藏！我从哪里开始，从哪里停止！

@@U04263@@
我从来没有见过这么多的战利品！首先要抓住什么？

@@U04265@@
那块地毯很适合我！你应该看看我睡过的破床。

@@U04267@@
啊！还有这里！钢钉狼牙棒！梦想成真！

@@U04269@@
看这里！这是一件带有金色镶边的红色斗篷！我一直想要其中一件！

@@U04271@@
（从墙上取下狼牙棒。）

@@U04272@@
打完这一招后，大脑就会变得一团糟，然后再进行下一个。让我们看看你有什么。啊!垃圾！留下它。拿走其中一个箱子。军队的饷。一肚子的金子。
